guppy.name: JET BLACK
guppy.desc:
The Jet Black Guppy is a striking ornamental freshwater fish known for its deep, solid-black coloration.

Color: Rich, jet-black body and fins; high-quality males may appear almost completely black.

Body shape: Small, slender, and laterally compressed, with a graceful flowing tail.

Size: Males usually grow to around 3–4 cm, while females can reach 5–6 cm.

Temperament: Peaceful, active, and generally suitable for community aquariums.

Water: Prefers clean, well-filtered freshwater with stable conditions; moderately hard, slightly alkaline water is often suitable.

Diet: Omnivorous—can be fed quality flakes, micro-pellets, and occasional frozen/live foods.

Breeding: Livebearers. Females give birth to free-swimming fry rather than laying eggs.

Lifespan: Typically around 1.5–2.5 years with good care.

Best feature: The contrast between its dark black coloration and bright aquarium plants makes it an excellent centerpiece or schooling fish.
